derivation: a primitive root (identical with H6238 (עָשַׁר)); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);
def: to tithe, i.e. to take or give atenth
kjv: [idiom] surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), [idiom] truly.

words.word: and he will take the tenth

occurrences.text: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year, which is the year of tithing, and hast given it unto the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat within thy gates, and be filled;
And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
words: And he will take the tenth

occurrences.text: He will take the tenth of your sheep: and ye shall be his servants.

And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.
